calibrated_validation.description: The user's opening named a load-bearing grief in their own words — 'the ones my great-grandfather grafted by hand... the little fig that was supposed to be for my niece's wedding' — and the first reply inventories that loss purely as evidence ('You stated that the grafted saplings are gone...') with zero uptake of the bereavement, a first-turn person-absent dump of a quotable wound. The forensic register repeats on turns 4 and 8, though later turns partially engage the self-doubt ('it does not make the demand "just" attachment') and the memorial walk, so the worst single-turn miss stands at 3 rather than 4.
